verdict.rationale: Highnote is a card-issuing and payments SaaS with a Dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no such assistant. Its 'agentic commerce' material covers issuing cards to external AI agents, and the 'agents add notes' mutation concerns servicing agents. Neither is an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
